dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It isn't very big, but it has a balcony.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈvɛri ˈbɪɡ, bʌt ɪt ˈhæz ə ˈbælkəni.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nice. How much is the rent per month?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs. ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈrɛnt pər ˈmʌnθ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's five thousand baht, and the deposit is ten thousand.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt, ənd ðə dɪˈpɑːzɪt ɪz ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, it doesn't. Electricity is about five hundred baht per month.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈdʌzənt. ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt pər ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And water? How much is that?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwɔːtər? ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðæt?
